SELECT coalesce(status, $8) AS status, id, token, context, timeout_ms, context_bytes,
                    CASE WHEN $7::boolean AND status = $9
                    THEN floor(extract($10 FROM pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()) * $11)::bigint::text END AS observed_at_ms,
                    ordinality::text
             FROM (VALUES ($12)) AS probe_anchor(dummy)
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                 SELECT * FROM mesh_jobs.claim_batch_v1($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4::bigint, $5::integer,
                     nullif($6, $13)::bigint) WITH ORDINALITY
             ) AS result ON $14
             WHERE CASE WHEN ordinality IS NOT NULL THEN $15 ELSE EXISTS (
                 SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.queues q
                 WHERE q.namespace = $1 AND q.name = $2 AND q.state = $16
                     AND q.concurrency > $17
                     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.queues paused
                         WHERE paused.namespace = $1 AND paused.name = $18 AND paused.state = $19)
                     AND q.concurrency > (SELECT count(*) FROM mesh_jobs.jobs running
                         WHERE running.namespace = q.namespace AND running.queue = q.name
                             AND running.state = $20)
                     AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
                         WHERE j.namespace = q.namespace AND j.queue = q.name
                             AND j.state IN ($21, $22, $23)
                             AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= coalesce(nullif($6, $24)::bigint,
                                 floor(extract($25 FROM pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()) * $26)::bigint)
                             AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
                             AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                                 WHERE w.worker = j.worker AND w.version = j.version)
                             AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                                 WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                                     AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                                     AND b.encoding = current_setting($27)::name))
             ) END
